## Projects Legend

### CBL-ReadingLists
Started off as the Marvel Master Reading Order + Others but has rapidly changed into support for all facets of reading lists.

### comic-ripper
Comic Ripper searches BatCave through a local Suwayomi server, asks Suwayomi to download chapters, and exports CBZ files. The normal setup does not require a browser, a custom extension build, or files outside this repository.

### factory
This repository is a verbatim snapshot of the autonomous software-factory setup currently used for ComicPile.
